messages:
sre-bot: PROD P1 alert — Embeddings API experiencing high latency and 429 errors in us-west. Pager fired. War room: https://zoom.redwood.ai/j/97531 (ops-1945678901). Ticket INC-1945678901. Impact: some customers reporting timeouts and elevated error rates. Starting internal kickoff, need owner + on-call ack.
kevin: ack — joining war room now. pinged oncall. I'll monitor pages. :raised_hand: 
maria: taking owner for incident. I'll look at routing + queue backpressure first. Joining war room.
alex: oncall infra here — checking autoscaler, GPU pool health, and node evictions.
samir: I'll draft a short status page + customer note while you triage. Draft below, please edit.
samir: ```Status: Degraded performance for Embeddings API — us-west
Start: 2026-03-17T14:15:01Z
Impact: Some API requests receiving 429s or timing out. A subset of customers in the us-west region may experience increased latency.
Current status: Engineers investigating; mitigations in progress.
Customer guidance: If you rely on embeddings in us-west, consider retrying with exponential backoff or routing to us-east. We will update as we have more information.```
maria: initial find — KV cache eviction backlog spiked, queue depth > 5k. Autoscaler didn't scale due to API quota errors when requesting more nodes. Investigating quota failures now.
alex: confirmed: autoscaler calls returning 403 from cloud quota service. Manually increased pool by spinning reserve nodes, enabling ephemeral burst. Adding a fallback route to us-east for critical customers.
kevin: enabled routing fallback policy for embedding-inference -> us-east for customers with multi-region flag. Notifying SRE to watch error rates.
samir: Posted interim status at https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1945678901 (internal draft). Suggested customer message posted to thread for review: ```We are currently investigating degraded performance for the Embeddings API in our US‑West region. Some requests may receive 429s or fail. We recommend retrying with exponential backoff or using our US‑East region as a temporary workaround. We'll update this page within 30 minutes or sooner with progress.```
maria: mitigation: cleared quota issue by rotating cloud service account and re-requesting scale. KV eviction backlog draining. Monitoring queue.
alex: observed error-rate drop: 429s from 14% -> 3% in last 5 minutes. Latency 95p down from 6.2s -> 1.1s.
kevin: great. I'll take postmortem ownership and coordinate customer comms once we have full timeline.
samir: updating status page to Open -> Investigating -> Mitigation in progress. Will schedule customer-facing follow-up email template for review.
maria: continuing root cause trace (IAM token expiry + autoscaler retry logic). Will post logs and runbook links in war room.
sre-bot: paging acknowledgements: kevin acknowledged at 14:15:30Z, maria acknowledged at 14:15:45Z, alex acknowledged at 14:16:05Z.
kevin: thanks all. If anything changes escalate to P0. I'll prepare the initial customer summary for legal/CS review. :thumbsup:
samir: next update in 10 mins unless status changes.
